{
 "path": "programs/task-f7bff12f.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # A solid vertical marker separates two equal-width masks; retain their overlap.
    w = len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] != 0 for row in grid))
    left_w = sep
    right_w = w - sep - 1
    n = min(left_w, right_w)
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][sep + 1 + c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(len(grid))]
"
